docs.title: StellarModdingAPI
docs.text: Welcome to the official documentation for StellarModdingAPI, the modding framework for StellarDrive.

docs.title: What is StellarModdingAPI?
docs.text: StellarModdingAPI allows developers to extend StellarDrive by creating custom content, behaviors, and gameplay modifications.

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• Create custom scripts
  • Modify game objects
  • Extend gameplay systems
  • Build community-made content

docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text:

Already familiar with the API?

docs.title: Requirements
docs.text:
Before creating mods, make sure you have:

  • StellarDrive installed
  • StellarModdingAPI installed
  • A code editor

docs.title: Installing the API
docs.text:
1. Download the latest version of StellarModdingAPI.
  2. Extract it into your StellarDrive directory.
  3. Launch StellarDrive.
